dbms=postgresql

table public.asset schema=public name=asset rows=0 triggers= comment=One physical asset (a single machine, sensor or instrument).
  col 1 uuid label=uuid type=uuid nullable=false default=gen_random_uuid() comment=null
  col 2 asset_type_id label=uuid type=uuid nullable=false default=null comment=null
  col 3 parent_asset_id label=uuid type=uuid nullable=true default=null comment=null
  col 4 location_id label=uuid type=uuid nullable=true default=null comment=null
  col 5 name label=text type=text nullable=true default=null comment=null
  col 6 code label=text type=text nullable=false default=null comment=Short unique code printed on the asset label.
  col 7 description label=text type=text nullable=true default=null comment=null
  col 8 add_info label=jsonb type=jsonb nullable=true default=null comment=null
  col 9 start label=timestamp without time zone type=timestamp without time zone nullable=false default=LOCALTIMESTAMP comment=null
  col 10 end label=timestamp with time zone type=timestamp with time zone nullable=true default=null comment=null
  pk=uuid pk_name=asset_pkey
  uq asset_code_key (code)
  fk asset_location_id_fkey (location_id) -> public.location(uuid) not_valid=false on_delete=null
  fk asset_parent_fkey (parent_asset_id) -> public.location(uuid) not_valid=true on_delete=null
  fk asset_asset_type_id_fkey (asset_type_id) -> public.asset_type(uuid) not_valid=false on_delete=null
  idx asset_code_key unique=true partial=false (code)
  idx asset_pkey unique=true partial=false (uuid)

table public.session schema=public name=session rows=0 triggers= comment=null
  col 1 uuid label=uuid type=uuid nullable=false default=gen_random_uuid() comment=null
  col 2 name label=text type=text nullable=false default=null comment=null
  col 3 description label=text type=text nullable=true default=null comment=null

  col 6 add_info label=jsonb type=jsonb nullable=true default=null comment=null
  pk=uuid pk_name=session_pkey
  check session_time_check CHECK (((time_end IS NULL) OR (time_end >= time_start)))
  idx session_pkey unique=true partial=false (uuid)
